commission: Require durable reproducible receipts for every absurd/ceremonial score, using deterministic RNG rather than improvised numbers.

selectedJudgmentJars.why: Keep the commission to absurd-score generation/receipts; do not turn it into a general analytics or metrics system.
Reuse existing typed-receipt discipline and do not invent a second receipt daemon or false delivery state.
Implement the smallest coherent scorer, router, regression, and receipt contract.

punchCardCompilation.input: request to issue an absurd ceremonial score
punchCardCompilation.rule: canonicalize -> SHA-256 seed -> deterministic counter-hash byte stream -> profile-specific exact score -> typed receipt
punchCardCompilation.nextState: score and stable receipt identity exist
punchCardCompilation.observable: same canonical request reproduces the same exact score and receipt fingerprint
punchCardCompilation.correction: user-supplied historical scores are preserved as external/manual receipts rather than silently rerolled

plan: Add a boot-discoverable absurd-score receipt skill with automatic trigger rules.
Add a dependency-free deterministic SHA-256 counter-stream scorer; do not use Python random or current time in the seed.
Support standard, imagegen-style, and casino-nuclear profiles while clearly labeling scores as ceremonial rather than quality metrics.
Make hidden rerolls impossible: score changes require an explicit edition/profile/subject change preserved in the receipt.
Add deterministic regression tests for repeatability, profile bounds, huge-score shape, manual legacy preservation, and no-time-in-seed behavior.
Route Fortress Core and Ritsu through the score skill whenever an absurd score is assigned.
Wire the regression into the authorized local contract runner without claiming it executed here.
Create a grandfathered receipt for the user-assigned Imagegen score 567,768 without pretending RNG generated that historical number.
Read back every changed artifact, then run a Venice completion/source review.
antagonism: Do not use wall-clock time, process randomness, Python hash(), or random.Random as score entropy; those undermine cross-run receipts.
Do not create a second Home Center receipt watcher; absurd-score receipts are repository artifacts, while existing receipt transport doctrine remains separate.
Do not launder ceremonial RNG into a real quality metric; the receipt must say it is absurd/ceremonial.
Do not reroll the same subject silently; an intentional new edition must be explicit and receipt-visible.
Do not overwrite the prior human-issued 567,768 score; preserve provenance as user-assigned legacy.
Do not require the user to say 'absurd score receipt' every time; task-class routing must fire when the assistant assigns an absurd score.
reviewerMemory: Planning bypass: research and Venice plan receipt must precede substantive mutation.
Status-without-capability: doctrine alone is insufficient; provide deterministic executable tooling and regression.
Evidence laundering: source/readback proves source state only; local runtime test execution will remain explicitly unclaimed unless actually run.
doneCondition: A canonical scoring skill, deterministic scorer, regression contract, global/Ritsu routing, runner wiring, grandfathered 567768 receipt, repository readback, and Venice STOP_ALLOWED completion receipt all exist on main.
